::: {.area-page-hero}
::: {.area-page-copy}
Cold is a protective environmental stress rather than merely an injury. We study how mild
hypothermia and RBM3 reorganise cellular metabolism, RNA regulation and mitochondrial function, and
whether those mechanisms can improve resilience without requiring cold exposure.
:::
